transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Member Services. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Hi, I got a medical bill and I can’t afford the full amount right now.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: I’m sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: It’s $412 and I’m struggling with rent this month too.

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Is there a payment plan, monthly, so I can pay over time?

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Let me look into options for you.
